code_examples.text:
when CLIENT_ACCEPTED {
   log local0. "Client [IP::client_addr], VS: [IP::local_addr],\
      \[IP::version\]: [IP::version], \[IP::protocol\]: [IP::protocol]"
}

# Log output for a TCP connection over IPv4:
# <CLIENT_ACCEPTED>: Client 10.1.0.11, VS: 10.1.0.15, [IP::version]: 4, [IP::protocol]: 6

# Log output for a TCP connection over IPv6:
# <CLIENT_ACCEPTED>: Client fc00::1, VS: fc00::2, [IP::version]: 6, [IP::protocol]: 6

text:
IP::version
Description
Returns the IP version of a connection (“4” or “6”). When called in a
clientside event, this command returns the IP version for the
clientside connection. When called in a serverside event, this command
returns the IP version for the serverside connection.
Syntax
IP
::
version
IP::version
Returns the IP version of a connection (“4” or “6”).
Examples
when
CLIENT_ACCEPTED
{
log
local0.
"Client [IP::client_addr], VS: [IP::local_addr],\
\[IP::version\]: [IP::version], \[IP::protocol\]: [IP::protocol]"
}
# Log output for a TCP connection over IPv4:
# <CLIENT_ACCEPTED>: Client 10.1.0.11, VS: 10.1.0.15, [IP::version]: 4, [IP::protocol]: 6
# Log output for a TCP connection over IPv6:
# <CLIENT_ACCEPTED>: Client fc00::1, VS: fc00::2, [IP::version]: 6, [IP::protocol]: 6
